journal.reimagined.page.introduction:
FIELD JOURNAL

Explore to record nearby creatures and visited biomes.

Biomes: %s
Creatures: %s

Open again to refresh your notes.
journal.reimagined.page.seasons:
SEASONS

A year lasts 96 days: four seasons of 24 days.

Use /reimagined calendar to check the date. Seasonal crop growth depends on the local biome.
journal.reimagined.page.skills:
SKILLS

Actions train ten skill trees. Levels continue indefinitely, but each tree has only three upgrade ranks.

/reimagined skills
/reimagined skills unlock <tree>
journal.reimagined.page.recipes:
RECIPES

Open inventory for the item browser. Search and filter; left click an item for recipes and right click for uses.

The browser includes crafting, cooking and milling.
journal.reimagined.page.engineering:
ENGINEERING

Flowing water turns a water wheel. Connect its axis to shafts and a millstone.

Wheels supply 16 load; mills use 8. Overload stops rotation. Hoppers automate milling.
journal.reimagined.page.magic:
MAGIC

Basic spells stay available. Create altar focuses, then table folios. Record 2 biomes / 1 creature first. Read a folio to learn. Sneak-use a wand to select. Rituals need amethyst.
journal.reimagined.page.combat:
COMBAT

Left click attacks normally. Sneak + right click uses a weapon special. Specials share a cooldown and cost durability.

Raise a shield just before a melee hit to parry.
journal.reimagined.page.undiscovered: No observations yet. Explore nearby terrain and look for living creatures.
journal.reimagined.page.wildlife:
FOREST DEER

Look in forests, taigas and meadows. Deer follow sweet berries. Feed two adults berries to breed a fawn.

Keep wolves away: deer flee from them.

journal.reimagined.page.cooking:
COOKING

Heat a pot over a campfire or magma. One hopper may sit between. Add ingredients and bowls. Barley + apple: porridge. Flour + mushrooms: dumplings. Browse recipes. Eating returns bowls.

reimagined.forge.guide: Forge iron equipment once: metal + leather/flint + coal, reusable iron hammer. Bellows and Smith rank 2 raise quality. See recipes.
reimagined.forge.slot.0: Unworked iron equipment. One-time treatment; names/enchantments/wear are retained.
reimagined.forge.slot.1: Metal: iron or steel ingot, as required by the recipe.
reimagined.forge.slot.2: Treatment: flint for a keen edge, leather for extra durability.
reimagined.forge.slot.3: Fuel: one coal/charcoal per completed operation. No idle burning.
reimagined.forge.slot.4: Reusable iron hammer. Loses 4 durability per operation; Unbreaking works normally.
reimagined.forge.slot.5: Optional bellows. With Smith rank 2+, raise quality by 1(max 3). Not consumed.
reimagined.forge.slot.6: Finished equipment. Repair it in the left anvil slot to retain its finish.
reimagined.forge.recipe_note: Base quality %s. Smith rank 2 + installed bellows: +1(max 3). Hammer is reused (4 wear); coal is consumed. Output shown at base quality; actual components/wear are retained. Cannot repeat treatment.
